subject: Off-cycle headcount ask: urgent Q3 reprioritization
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, talent-partner@bigbench.co
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Off-cycle headcount ask: urgent Q3 reprioritization

Team —

Quick context before the QBR tomorrow: Product infra has an emergent capacity/latency project tied to two OKR commitments (Reduce tail latency by 15% and scale inference throughput x2). We have an open backfill req (REQ-3921) for a Senior Infra Engineer that the engineers say is critical to hit the annealing work and the runtime kernel updates. If we don’t reallocate headcount now, we risk missing the OKR milestone and the QBR narrative will be a remediation ask.

What I’m asking for:
- Approve an off-cycle hire for REQ-3921 (Senior Infra Eng, 1 headcount) OR approve a freeze but provide an executable contingency (contractor + 2-week ramp) by EOD today.
- If freeze accepted, sign off on deprioritizing the PM II req that is currently unfilled (we can delay that hire by 1 quarter).

Why this matters (short):
- Impact to OKRs: Infra lead says the work contributes 60% of the latency reduction target; delay likely pushes objective to red.
- QBR optics: we’ll need a clear ask & mitigation to present to the execs.

Attachments: REQ-3921_infra_sr_eng.pdf (JD + compensation band), QBR-headcount-ask-note.pdf (one-pager I drafted).

Please reply with Approve / Freeze + contingency by 5pm today. If you prefer, I can pull a short tradeoff matrix for the exec summary — need a volunteer to validate numbers.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, talent-partner@bigbench.co
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Off-cycle headcount ask: urgent Q3 reprioritization

Hannah — thank you for the context and the one-pager. I agree we need to protect the latency OKR, but finance has put a hiring cap on unplanned headcount for Q3 (freeze level 2). I’m inclined to a compromise: Approve 1 headcount partially-funded from the existing product ops underspend and route the remaining cost to a contingent contractor for 3 months while we confirm runway in July. If we do this we’ll need a clear acceptance criteria tied to the QBR milestone (deliverables + dates).

Action: Hannah, can you draft a 1-paragraph acceptance criteria we can include in the QBR slide? Jordan/Vanessa, please weigh in on whether converting an internal contractor to this role is feasible. I’ll loop finance if we move forward.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, talent-partner@bigbench.co
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Off-cycle headcount ask: urgent Q3 reprioritization

Hannah / team —

I support prioritizing the Infra hire over the PM II role for the quarter. One practical ask: can someone run a quick tradeoff matrix that shows OKR impact vs. cost (I made a skeleton and attached it). If we present a single-slide tradeoff with numbers (delta to latency OKR, projected revenue/ops impact, cost delta) the execs will be more comfortable approving a single headcount exception.

If Soojin wants to move to a hybrid approach (1 hire + contractor) I can live with that, but we should confirm availability of the contractor and the expected ramp weeks. Vanessa — can you check with the serving runtime lead about whether the infra work is on the critical path (I want a 1-line confirmation to include in the slide).

Attachment: Headcount-tradeoff-matrix.xlsx (skeleton with three scenarios).

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference

> On Wed, Jun 30, 2027 at 11:02 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> > Hannah — thank you for the context and the one-pager....

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Off-cycle headcount ask: urgent Q3 reprioritization

All — thanks for the fast responses. HR can support either path but needs explicit direction from leadership to action Workday statuses today. Next steps I will take once I get an explicit Approve / Freeze + contingency:

1) If Approve: we will convert REQ-3921 from Open->Approved in Workday and post to the talent partner; I’ll route offer approvals through the usual compensation committee but mark it urgent.
2) If Freeze + contingency: we will pause REQ-3921 and fast-track a contractor conversion (if vendor available) for up to 12 weeks and update recruiting slate accordingly.

I’ve uploaded the attachments Hannah referenced to the shared drive and added a short HR note with the compensation band and the hiring timeline. Links: https://drive.redwood.company/Shared/Q3-Headcount/Offcycle-Requests and JIRA-REQ-3921.

Please reply with a single line: APPROVE or FREEZE+CONTRACTOR by 5pm PT. If I don’t receive a clear direction we will default to FREEZE per hiring governance.

Attachments uploaded: REQ-3921_infra_sr_eng.pdf, QBR-headcount-ask-note.pdf.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Talent Partner, People Ops
Redwood Inference
